title: ArcCivs 0.1.36: active farmer care and bounded crop growth
assumptions: Scenario assumptions, not measured telemetry: low/base/high are 1/10/16 cities, 1/2/12 farmers, farm levels 1/2/3, and 1/2/4 productive daylight hours per city-day. The high case uses the full 12-resident city cap across multiple farms; placement and daily online time are not guaranteed.

Before care, illustrative wheat-only harvest rates are 10/20/40 completed crops per farmer-hour: 10/80/1920 crops per city-day. Native drops and replant seed handling are unchanged; one mature wheat crop supplies one wheat. Carrot/potato baskets and Fortune effects are not assigned a guessed monetary or item value.

All three supported crops have native age 0..7. Watering may advance only age3 to4 once per growth cycle. Optional fertilizing consumes one plain BONE_MEAL and advances only age5 to6. Native age checkpoints prevent repeated boosts by multiple farmers or restart; asynchronous receipts fence exact changed cells.

Growth-limited theoretical bounds with immediate care are 6/7 of former growth time for watering and 5/7 with fertilizing: throughput at most 7/6 or7/5. Travel, four-second care jobs, hungry slowdown, missed checkpoints, light, growth rules, viewer absence, storage and native tick randomness reduce realized gains; no measured percentage is claimed.

Low scenario uses watering only; base uses equal shares of watering-only and fertilized harvests; high uses fertilizing whenever eligible. Expected after wheat/city-day is 11.666666667/102.666666667/2688. These are illustrative upper sensitivities, not guaranteed grants.

Care has no direct Vault/tokens/player XP emission and no internal profession points or hoe durability charge. Normal harvest training, hunger, caps and native material drops remain unchanged. No offline catch-up or crop timer creates output items.

Automatic care is bounded by the existing shared worksite slice and resident lifecycle. Four seconds permits at most900 fed or450 hungry care actions per productive farmer-hour before travel/other actions. This ceiling cannot simultaneously be added to a full-time harvest ceiling.

Bone meal is optional and sourced from actual resident items/local storage using the existing receipt; no shortage blocks watering. Logistics targets16 bone meal per assigned farmer. Water comes from existing farm irrigation and no transferable bucket is created.

Read-only 168h economy audit on classic was unavailable: ops HTTP tunnel reset. Direct monetary delta is established from the changed source path, while current SELL/contract redemption and ordinary player income remain unknown. Existing EconomyShopGUI SELL is retained as a possible current flow; the owner's future contract-only plan is not assumed active.

No price or progression cost changes, so days-to-save is not derived. Multiple accounts can multiply independent farms but not repeat a given age checkpoint. Manual bone meal can already accelerate native growth; this change adds no bone-meal creation or buy/process/resell price claim.

Continuous active care also uses the existing hunger rule: at most1 hunger per active minute and1 real bread restores6. An upper incremental feeding sensitivity, versus an otherwise idle waiting farmer, is10 bread per productive farmer-hour:10/40/480 bread per city-day. This is not a measured before/after duty cycle; existing work already incurs hunger, and absent bread leads to the existing hungry slowdown, not free food. No hunger rate is changed.

The 7/6 and7/5 throughput sensitivities compare otherwise equally healthy irrigated crops at the same native growth rate per stage. They bound the age-checkpoint contribution, not arbitrary external growth plugins or a formerly dry/damaged field. Moisture maintenance can transiently restore normal hydration; its realized effect and native random-tick settings are not measured.

flows.basis: Wheat-only illustrative harvest sensitivity; no direct item grant at care completion.
One actual bone meal for each paid age5-to6 care; low no fertilizer, base half fertilized, high all eligible.
Upper incremental food cost if formerly waiting minutes become working minutes; existing1 hunger/min and6 per bread, no free food. Not additive to another full-time job.
